about: Every voiced line in the game. The single source of truth: game/src/voice.cpp emits the situations, game/web/voice.js plays these lines, docs/VOICE_LINES.md is generated from this file (python3 tools/voice/script.py).

situations.title: Selected
situations.when: The player picks him (or his squad).

situations.title: Move ordered
situations.when: Acknowledging a march order.

situations.title: Attack ordered
situations.when: Acknowledging an order to attack.

situations.title: Charge
situations.when: Charging: ordered, or riders breaking into the gallop.

situations.title: Incoming charge
situations.when: Horse thundering down on them.

situations.title: Hold the line!
situations.when: A veteran's rally call to wavering friends nearby.

situations.title: Hero rallies
situations.when: A hero's rally call to wavering or broken troops.

situations.title: Rallied
situations.when: Turning back to the fight after breaking.

situations.title: Wavering
situations.when: Fear creeping in; morale low.

situations.title: Breaking
situations.when: Broken: dropping everything and running.

situations.title: Our hero fell
situations.when: Their own hero cut down near them.

situations.title: Enemy hero fell
situations.when: The enemy's hero cut down.

situations.title: Friend killed
situations.when: A comrade killed beside him.

situations.title: First kill
situations.when: His first kill of the battle.

situations.title: Veteran's kill
situations.when: A veteran's kill: a taunt.

situations.title: Promoted
situations.when: Rank up (a hero: level up).

situations.title: Badly wounded
situations.when: Down to a third of his strength.

situations.title: Under arrow fire
situations.when: Arrows falling on them.

situations.title: Flanked
situations.when: Struck from the side or behind.

situations.title: Friendly fire
situations.when: Hit by his own side's arrows or bombs.

situations.title: Fire in the hole
situations.when: A grenadier lights and throws a satchel.

situations.title: Healing
situations.when: A healer mends a wounded friend.

situations.title: Engine looses
situations.when: The catapult throws a stone.

situations.title: Gate broken
situations.when: The gate gives way.

situations.title: Enemy sighted
situations.when: First contact with the enemy.

situations.title: Victory
situations.when: The battle is won.

situations.title: Defeat
situations.when: The battle is lost.

situations.title: Idle chatter
situations.when: Rare, when nothing has happened for a while.

situations.title: Hurt
situations.when: Struck and hurt, still standing: a grunt or a cry.

situations.title: Death cry
situations.when: Killed: a scream, or a last grunt as he goes down.

situations.title: Shot dead
situations.when: Killed by an arrow: a short, choking moan.

situations.title: Grenadier's glee
situations.when: A grenadier whose satchel has just killed: a manic cackle.

situations.title: Undead groan
situations.when: The walking dead, idly: a groan, a click of the jaw.

situations.title: Casualties
situations.when: A quarter of the player's soldiers have fallen.

situations.title: Severe casualties
situations.when: Half of the player's soldiers have fallen.

situations.title: Total casualties
situations.when: Four fifths of the player's soldiers have fallen.

situations.title: A wave comes
situations.when: Horde: the next wave sets out for the hill.

situations.title: A champion comes
situations.when: Horde: a boss wave, a demon or a dragon at its head.

situations.title: Wave beaten
situations.when: Horde: the last of the wave is down or fled; the break begins.

situations.title: Reinforcements
situations.when: Horde: fresh troops bought in the break reach the hill.

situations.title: The hill is taken
situations.when: Horde: the enemy stands on the hill and none of ours do; it is lost unless retaken.

situations.title: Flag under attack
situations.when: Capture the flag: enemies close on the player's flag.

situations.title: Our flag fell
situations.when: Capture the flag: an enemy stood on the player's flag with none of ours there.

situations.title: An enemy flag fell
situations.when: Capture the flag: another team's flag is taken.
